answer_1.quote: Text generation is a fundamental NLP task that returns the best text given a context. This paper focuses on decision rules regarding the choice of outputs in conditional text generation.

answer_2.quote: We used CHRF and COMET for the utility function, and CometKiwi (KIWI) for the QE model. We evaluated the translation quality on CHRF, COMET, and BLEURT (BLRT). We also measured the execution time... We evaluated captions on BLEU, CHRF, and BS.
